verdict.rationale: Bento is a SaaS that ingests customers' agent traces, so a training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence never documents any opt-out, data-use policy, or control that stops customer data from training AI models. The only related mention is that Bento "trains a signal on your own traces", which describes a product feature, not a privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
